# ipzilon_subnets (Data Source)

List subnets. Provide id (singular), network_id, zone_id, name or cidr. name and cidr do not need network_id (IPzilon >= 3.2.0).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all subnets in a network
data "ipzilon_subnets" "all" {
  network_id = 1
}

output "subnet_cidrs" {
  value = [for s in data.ipzilon_subnets.all.items : s.cidr]
}

# Subnets inside a zone (IPzilon >= 3.1.0); network_id is not required
data "ipzilon_subnets" "pooled" {
  zone_id = data.ipzilon_network_zones.pooled.items[0].id
}

# Subnets of a network outside every zone (IPzilon >= 3.1.0)
data "ipzilon_subnets" "outside_zones" {
  network_id = ipzilon_network.example.id
  no_zone    = true
}

# Lookup a subnet by its CIDR only, without network_id (IPzilon >= 3.2.0).
# The same CIDR may exist in several hubs: add network_id to narrow it down.
data "ipzilon_subnets" "hosts" {
  cidr = "10.0.16.64/26"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cidr` (String) Filter: subnets whose network equals this CIDR (server-side, IPzilon >= 3.2.0). Must be a CIDR without host bits; network_id is not required.
- `id` (Number) Lookup a single subnet by ID. Cannot be combined with other filters.
- `name` (String) Filter: exact name match (server-side, IPzilon >= 3.2.0). network_id is not required.
- `network_id` (Number) Filter: subnets of this network. Optional with zone_id, name or cidr; required with no_zone.
- `no_zone` (Boolean) When true, list only the subnets of network_id outside every zone (IPzilon >= 3.1.0). Requires network_id; cannot be combined with zone_id, name or cidr.
- `zone_id` (Number) List the subnets inside this zone (IPzilon >= 3.1.0). network_id is not required.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) Matching subnets; an empty list when nothing matches. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `cidr` (String) Subnet CIDR block.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `id` (Number) Subnet ID.
- `name` (String) Subnet name.
- `network_id` (Number) ID of the network the subnet belongs to.
- `zone_id` (Number) Zone that contains the subnet (null if none; IPzilon >= 3.1.0).
